name: How can I prevent black spots or mold from returning on my walls?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black spots or mold from returning on my walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing black spots or mold on walls primarily involves controlling moisture and humidity. Ensure proper ventilation in bathrooms and kitchens, especially after showering or cooking. Repair any leaks promptly, whether from plumbing or roof issues. Use dehumidifiers in damp areas like basements. Maintaining indoor humidity levels below 60% and ensuring good air circulation throughout your home can significantly reduce the conditions conducive to mold growth. Regular cleaning also helps.
